lines.zh: 我离地半尺，慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I float half a foot up and drift forward.

lines.zh: 脚不沾地，尘土都追不上我。
lines.en: My feet never touch down; the dust can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我从树顶的高度掠过去。
lines.en: I skim past at treetop height.

lines.zh: 我的披风在身后拉成一条线。
lines.en: My cape trails behind me as a straight line.

lines.zh: 我压低一点，贴着草尖飞。
lines.en: I sink lower, skimming the grass tips.

lines.zh: 翅膀不动，我却一直在前进。
lines.en: My wings don't beat, yet I keep moving.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片空地转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the clearing once.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶过去，你没抬头。
lines.en: I pass over your head and you don't look up.

lines.zh: 落地那一下，土被压出坑。
lines.en: When I land, the soil takes a dent.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但从不迷路。
lines.en: I don't fly fast, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让风从肩后过。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let the wind pass behind my shoulder.

lines.zh: 影子里多了一片，那是我。
lines.en: There's an extra shape in your shadow — that's me.
I let my hands hang and watch the clouds move.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角翻来翻去。
lines.en: The wind keeps flipping my hem.
I exhale slowly; pale mist drifts away.

lines.zh: 我落在土坡上，先试试地。
lines.en: I land on a rise and test the ground first.
I'm sizing up this airspace.

lines.zh: 我背上有点僵，转了转肩。
lines.en: My back is stiff; I roll my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我不需要坐下，站着就够。
lines.en: No need to sit; standing will do.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到眼前，看指节。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my knuckles.

lines.zh: 远处没有动静，我就再等。
lines.en: Nothing stirs out there, so I wait longer.

lines.zh: 我听着风里有没有别的气息。
lines.en: I listen for anything else in the wind.
Light drops through a cloud gap onto my shoulder.
I settle lower and hover in place.
My cloth rustles faintly in the wind.
From up here, you look small.

lines.zh: 我悬在你头顶，别抬头太久。
lines.en: I hang above you; don't look up too long.

lines.zh: 你的气，我隔着风也闻得到。
lines.en: I smell your ki even through the wind.

lines.zh: 你站着的姿势，很像猎物。
lines.en: The way you stand looks like prey.
When I land, the ground will answer.

lines.zh: 你不是本地人，也不是我的任务。
lines.en: You're not local, and not my mission.

lines.zh: 你要不要先说话？我等着。
lines.en: Will you speak first? I'm waiting.
One reach and I'm at your crown.
Your breathing caught for a moment.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，可你躲不开。
lines.en: I'm not quick, but you can't dodge me.

lines.zh: 我身后没有退路这两个字。
lines.en: Retreat isn't a word I carry.
I'll count to three, and then you should run.

lines.zh: 风把我的影子打在你脚下。
lines.en: The wind lays my shadow at your feet.
No one beside you. Good.
The sky here belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降下来，你退了一步。
lines.en: I descend slowly, and you take a step back.

lines.zh: 擦了一下，我连呼吸都没乱。
lines.en: A graze, and my breathing doesn't change.
Pain is new to me, and I like it.
I sway, then steady my hover.
That was hard, but not enough.
There's a tear in my cape.
Blood falls and lands on the grass.
I grit my teeth and my eye twitches.
I give half a pace, then return.
This wound changes nothing.
I settle my weight again.
I have no use for that.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我反而想笑。
lines.en: Holding food up at me is almost funny.
Eating lost its meaning for me long ago.

lines.zh: 别再拿着晃了，我看腻了。
lines.en: Stop waving it around; I'm bored of it.
Food isn't what keeps me going.
You can eat it; I won't take it.

lines.zh: 我闻到烟火气，那是你的。
lines.en: I smell cookfire smoke — that's yours.
That's a poor bribe.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面替我挡了你。
lines.en: I land, and the ground stops you for me.
Shoulder to shoulder, and you yield.
Don't stand where I take off and land.
My knee is higher than your waist.

lines.zh: 你被气流推得偏了一步。
lines.en: The draft pushes you off a step.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个树荫里。
lines.en: We share one patch of shade.
You knock me partly sideways.
Watch your path, don't bump me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我落地压出的坑。
lines.en: You step into the crater I left.
Among my kind we speak only of feats.
It holds a little higher than I do.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一个眼神就散开。
lines.en: One exchanged look, and we scatter.
I give it half this airspace.

lines.zh: 它的气息很稳，我记住了。
lines.en: Its aura is steady; I noted it.
We dived together once.
No pleasantries, only a nod.
We each keep one flight line.

lines.zh: 地上这点东西，我拿得起。
lines.en: I can lift what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不用弯腰，手一伸就到。
lines.en: No need to bend; my hand reaches.
I keep this roll of cloth.

lines.zh: 一枚铁片，正好压住衣角。
lines.en: An iron scrap would weigh my hem down.
I pick things up without touching down.
What you dropped, I'm not returning.
I close it in my palm.
I touch down, pick it up, and rise again.
This weighs very little.
I tuck it into my sash as I go.

lines.zh: 风一变，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: When the wind shifts, I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我从上方扣住你的退路。
lines.en: I take the air above and cut your retreat.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一瞬，我已经动了。
lines.en: The instant you look up, I've already moved.
This one comes from the sky.
I have exactly one target.

lines.zh: 别往树林跑，我飞得进去。
lines.en: Don't run for the trees; I fly between them.
Your ki just flared.
Before I dive, everything goes quiet.
You're standing still. Good.
I bring my hand up beside my shoulder.
No margin this time.
Look above you.
I drop my altitude.
You're directly below me now.

lines.zh: 任务开始了，你准备好了吗？
lines.en: The mission has started. Are you ready?

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，是你的倒计时。
lines.en: My landing is your countdown.
I make small circles around you.
You run; I keep pace above.

lines.zh: 树冠挡得住视线，挡不住我。
lines.en: The canopy blocks sight, not me.

lines.zh: 你每躲一次，我都记着角度。
lines.en: Every dodge, I remember the angle.
My shadow stays on you.
Hear the wind? That's me.
Hiding in a hole won't help.
I've cut the gap to three paces.
I stay above and to your side.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，在草上很清楚。
lines.en: Your steps read clearly in the grass.
I clear my mind of everything else.
A few more seconds for you.
Your shoulder is sagging left.
I know where you'll run.
I've sealed this whole airspace.
You looked back; time to drop.

lines.zh: 我从上而下砸在你肩上。
lines.en: I come down on your shoulder.
One combo, then another.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，风被挡在外面。
lines.en: I close in and the wind is shut out.
Here's a small ki blast for you.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带着飞行速度。
lines.en: My fist carries the speed of flight.
That lifts you a foot off the ground.

lines.zh: 我用手背扫过你的侧脸。
lines.en: The back of my hand sweeps your cheek.
You fall back, and I'm above you.
Only after that do I touch down.
The last hit of the combo is the heaviest.
Your armor is creaking.
I pin you to the ground.
This one carries no feeling.
Did you hear that dull crack?
My speed owes nothing to the ground.
When it's over, we talk.
I drop here from high above.

lines.zh: 天空裂开一道影，那是我。
lines.en: A shape tears the sky — that's me.
When I land, the grass lies in a ring.

lines.zh: 我被派到这里，任务很清楚。
lines.en: I was sent here; the mission is clear.
I hover and read the whole field first.
The wind suddenly stops.

lines.zh: 我的气息一出现，鸟都飞散了。
lines.en: The birds scatter the moment my aura shows.
This is the start, not the end.
I shake out my cape.
I descend out of a cloud's shadow.
I close my fist once.

lines.zh: 这片地方，现在是我的战场。
lines.en: This ground is my battlefield now.
I open my eyes and find the target first.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，比你高一大截。
lines.en: Standing straight, I tower over you.
The air has gotten heavier.
I'm here; no need to be surprised.

lines.zh: 脚下的土还留着我上次的坑。
lines.en: The soil still holds my last crater.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，看了看地界。
lines.en: I lift my chin and survey the boundary.

lines.zh: 火在皮肤上散开，热得很钝。
lines.en: Fire spreads on my skin, dull and hot.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬地上，比被打更闷。
lines.en: Hitting hard ground is duller than any blow.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，飞行也救不了我。
lines.en: Water pours in, and flight can't save me.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得撞上树干。
lines.en: The blast slams me into a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 光弹打在我胸口，烫了一下。
lines.en: A ki blast hits my chest and burns.
Something has locked my ki.

lines.zh: 我靠着气撑着，饿也在磨我。
lines.en: My ki carries me, but hunger grinds too.

lines.zh: 雷打进身体，我从半空掉了一截。
lines.en: Lightning enters me and I drop partway.

lines.zh: 在这里飞，等于往无底里坠。
lines.en: Flying here is falling into nothing.
